text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, this restaurant is fully booked too...
Where should we hold the party...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Father's return date is coming up soon...
If things stay like this...!
Uuu~~, what should I doooo?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan? I-Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan! ...Ah, that's it!
Hey, there's something I need help with...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—I see. The friendly fishmonger's grandchild is
going to be born soon, so you want to gift them
a picture book to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! But there are so many that I can't decide!
I want you to help me pick one out, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! If you're okay with Rice,
I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's a present for a little kid, so something
easy to understand would be great!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then how about a pop-up picture book...?! 
Because it's visually fun to look at...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Also, I'd recommend fairy tales. They carry
a nice message and can still be enjoyed as they grow up...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I get it! Fairy tales sound super good!

And so, after browsing various bookstores together
for several hours—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The pop-up fairy tale book is decided! 
I'm so glad we found a great one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa?! It's completely dark outside!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Rice-chan! I took up so much of your time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu, no, it's fine. Rice had lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Besides, seeing you so happy makes Rice
happy too. So please don't apologize—

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...It's okay to rely on us.
It makes us happier when you do."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(Did Father and Mother feel the exact same way
back then as Rice feels right now...?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (If that's the case............)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... listen, Urara-chan!
Actually, Rice is having some trouble too—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—This time, I want to throw a party so
Father and Mother can have a wonderful time...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... I can't decide on anything by myself...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, U-Urara-chan... could you... help me...?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehh!! Help you out, Rice-chan...?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it, I'll do it! Urara wants to see
Rice-chan smiling too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's go ask the others too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If it's for you, Rice-chan,
everyone will gladly lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan—okay...! 
I'll... try asking them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-san, thank you so much! 
Yes, please book the venue there...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, we'll order food from the place Curren-san
recommended... and next is... next is............

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm, you see... I'm looking for a place
where we can rehearse for the party...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to make it a total success this time,
so I have to prepare properly...!

I'll help you look for one

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Rice thinks so too...! 
Because everyone is working hard to help out...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for listening to me, um...
I'll go search a bit more to see if there's a better place...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure, um...?
choice_data_list: I'd be glad if I could help.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: !! U-Um, okay...! In that case, um...!

After looking around the academy with Rice Shower,
we managed to get permission to use the cafeteria...
I wished from the bottom of my heart for her plan to succeed.
